extracted.intended_audience: general readers, historians, and members/clergy of the Lutheran Church interested in the history of Lutherans in New York
extracted.subtask_description: A historical monograph tracing the story and institutional problems of Lutheran churches in New York from the 17th century through the early 20th century, aimed at informing both Lutherans and the wider public. Includes narrative history, discussion of doctrinal distinctions, and a problems section (synods, language, membership, education, statistics).
